dedupe_keys.name: global facility level solar photovoltaic inventory with generation and loss estimates

description: This Zenodo deposit is a global inventory of 140,945 solar photovoltaic facilities in 181 countries, each with a panel footprint polygon and estimates of energy generation and atmospheric losses under different sky conditions. The authors, at the universities of Oxford, London, Leicester and Bath, found candidate sites by combining existing records, crowdsourced maps and a convolutional network on satellite images, then joined atmospheric data to model output. Facilities were catalogued from 2017 to 2024 and generation and loss are given for 2017 to 2023. Files are a GeoPackage, a GeoParquet, an attribute CSV and seven yearly CSV files, free to download from the record under CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: it is version 1.0.0 of one deposit with no stated update plan, generation values are modelled, not metered, and detection from imagery can miss small or new sites. It suits capacity planning, siting and hazard exposure studies of solar assets. Related catalogue records: data-global-renewables-watch-solar-wind, data-gem-global-solar-power-tracker and data-global-pv-solar-panel-maps-2019-2022.
